basis: Inherited peripheral neuropathy; denervation causes persistent muscle atrophy and foot deformities in most patients.
Germinoma arising within the adult central nervous system.
Infantile neurologic disease with defining osseous fragility; insufficient evidence to assign additional organs.
Defining osteochondrodysplasia and short stature; horseshoe kidney occurs in 30-79% but does not establish impaired renal function.
Malignancy arising in the urachus, a urinary bladder remnant.
Defining skeletal, urinary and anorectal malformations; hydrocephalus/cortical atrophy 80-99%. Ear, lung, liver, eye and cardiac anomalies omitted by cap.
Squamous cell carcinoma arising from skin.
Embryonal malignancy arising in the cerebral hemispheres.
Distal renal acidification defect with hypokalemic metabolic acidosis; sensorineural hearing loss affects a substantial share, often over 30%.
Malignancy originating in the lung apex; plexus and chest-wall invasion vary and are not established as common across this concept.
Marrow lymphoblast malignancy; leukemic hepatic infiltration with hepatomegaly occurs in roughly 50-70%. CNS involvement is a minority.
Neuronal migration disorder with periventricular heterotopia, microcephaly, seizures and severe developmental impairment.
Anterior horn cell degeneration; persistent denervation amyotrophy and associated foot deformities are characteristic and common.
Defined by sensorineural hearing loss, premature hair graying and essential tremor; blue sclerae do not establish ocular damage.
Chronic bacterial infection of internal organs, predominantly lungs; other visceral sites are not established as common.
Defining intellectual disability; dental crowding 3/4 and dentition anomalies 30-79%; scoliosis 30-79%, kyphosis 2/4. Recurrent infections do not prove immunodeficiency.
Autoinflammation with oral ulcers 4/4 and gastritis 2/2; arthritis reported in 1/1 assessed. Rash may be transient; iron deficiency anemia is separately coded.
CYP51A1 sterol-biosynthesis disorder with congenital cataracts and severe neonatal hepatopathy; global developmental delay is a defining feature.
Oxidative phosphorylation disorder; developmental delay, seizures and cerebral white-matter abnormalities in 1/1. Cardiac arrest alone does not prove cardiac disease.
Cancer predisposition without intrinsic organ damage; associated cancers are separate diagnoses and do not justify organ labels for susceptibility alone.
Severe coagulation disorder with dermal microvascular thrombosis and hemorrhagic skin necrosis; infection is a possible trigger rather than an intrinsic mechanism.
Inherited ossifying fibromas are bone lesions; dental displacement and impaction are reported without sufficient frequency evidence for an additional axis.
EBV-associated B-cell lymphoma; localization varies with the chronically inflamed site, so no additional organ applies consistently.
Congenital arterial abnormalities; supplied phenotype confirms cardiovascular involvement.
Metabolic bone disease with defective mineralization from vitamin D or calcium deficiency or abnormal vitamin D metabolism.
